about: The weblayer QA rules. scripts/weblayer_checks.py reads this file, so change a word list or threshold here and nowhere else. Each key is explained under notes; references/check-catalog.md says what each check means and its severity.

notes.placeholder_hosts: A link or image on one of these hosts is a placeholder (warning).
notes.placeholder_words: A link whose path or query contains one of these words as a whole word looks like a placeholder (warning).
notes.allowed_loads: Script, stylesheet and network targets the platform skeleton needs: the utils.js and intl-tel-input files under /brstatic/, the API base the skeleton uses in the editor preview, and the intl-tel-input utilities on jsDelivr. relative_paths are matched as path prefixes of relative URLs; each hosts entry is an exact https host, optionally followed by a path prefix. Anything else is an unexplained external load (warning) for the owner to confirm.
notes.timing_param_patterns: Regular expressions (case-insensitive) for parameter names that hold old triggering code. Timing belongs in Smart triggering, so these are a warning. Auto-close (removeAfter, AutoHideDelay) isn't triggering and isn't listed.
notes.timing_listener_events: Event listeners that usually mean triggering code (exit intent, scroll, tab switch). A warning to review: timing belongs in Smart triggering.
notes.param_types: The template parameter types Bloomreach accepts. Any other type is a warning.
notes.copy_min_chars: Visible HTML text with at least this many letters that isn't a parameter or Jinja is hard-coded copy (nitpick).
notes.max_data_uri_kb: An inline data: URI larger than this many kilobytes slows every page the weblayer runs on (warning).
notes.max_source_kb: HTML, CSS and JavaScript together larger than this many kilobytes (nitpick).
notes.list_limit: How many examples to list in one finding, such as hard-coded colours.
notes.excerpt_chars: The longest code excerpt quoted in a finding. Email addresses in excerpts are always masked.
